question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as EXP-INTEL-37982024058, does supplying the task goal and the action schema in the system prompt (removing the underspecification identified by audit VF-01, in the style of the granparent harness min_webagent.py) convert M-7B-QWEN's or M-3B-QWEN's step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion of the minimal Web-agent task; and if it does not, what is the demonstrable capability ceiling for that task across ALL credential-free endpoints and local models actually available to the factory (local 0.5B/3B/7B GGUFs, anonymous proxy), as bounded by a time-boxed external check of published results for comparably sized local models? The packet must return an explicit close/re-scope recommendation resolving readiness condition (3).
hypothesis: H1: At least one of M-7B-QWEN or M-3B-QWEN will clear the pre-declared capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over 5 seeded episodes) when the system prompt enumerates the task goal ('click the button, then answer the revealed value') and the action schema without leaking the literal answer TARGET-42, thereby converting the parent FALSIFIES (which audit VF-01 bounds to the underspecified prompt) into SUPPORTS at the goal/schema prompt protocol and unblocking the frozen C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark.
falsifier: H0: Even with the goal/schema-enriched prompt, neither M-7B-QWEN nor M-3B-QWEN clears the bar (under the deterministic protocol: task_success_rate < 0.6 in both models, i.e. <= 2/5 each), and the within-experiment comparator re-run reproduces the parent's VF-01 failure mode (0/5 success, re-click loop, answer_action_emission_rate 0.0), confirming the failure is below the prompt ceiling. Then the demonstrable capability ceiling for the minimal Web-agent task across ALL credential-free endpoints actually available (0.5B/3B/7B local GGUFs, anonymous gpt-oss-20b proxy) is below the bar, and the bounded external check either (a) finds no published evidence that any comparably sized credential-free-local model clears an equal-or-harder multi-step Web-agent task, licensing an explicit re-scope of the four-arm benchmark off the credential-free path, or (b) points at a specific credible external result to verify in a bounded follow-up before closing.

positive_control.description: Two positive controls, both with stable IDs preserved for downstream reuse. (1) PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING (gate, ID inherited from parent): 10 constrained-decoding probes per model per prompt condition with probe 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}'; verifies the GBNF decoder + strict parser produce schema-valid JSON under the prompt condition actually used for that arm. Decision-critical gate: a candidate whose treatment PC fails is EXCLUDED from treatment evaluation. (2) PC-ORACLE-EPISODE (new, scorer-path canary): 5 scripted episodes in which a fixed oracle producer emits click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42, executed through the SAME episode scorer (run_episode in the frozen parent harness) that scores candidate episodes; proves the full success path (click -> reveal detected -> answer registered -> task_success=true) can fire under the exact implementation that will score the experiment.
positive_control.success_criterion: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING: 10/10 schema-valid JSON per model per prompt condition. PC-ORACLE-EPISODE: 5/5 task_success=true with revealed_value=TARGET-42 in all 5 scripted episodes.
positive_control.failure_mode_policy: PC-JSON failure for a candidate under the treatment prompt -> that candidate is excluded from treatment evaluation (decoding_infrastructure_failure), never a capability verdict. PC-ORACLE < 5/5 -> scoring pipeline broken; OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID regardless of candidate results, because the scorer cannot register success.

null_control.description: 5 episodes with fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') driven through the same episode scorer; verifies the verification logic rejects non-parseable actions.

measurement_validity: Same minimal Web-agent task as parent (click #reveal-btn then answer the revealed value TARGET-42 on the identical synthetic page) for direct comparability across EXP-INTEL-37973264582, EXP-INTEL-37982024058 and this experiment.

Same harness code as the audited parent: research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py is REUSED UNMODIFIED (its sha256 is bound in freeze_artifacts). All prompts, the user template, task page, GBNF grammar, sampling and thresholds are config-driven; EXECUTE only transcribes per-condition harness_config.json files whose content is fully determined by the frozen strings in this packet (prereg sections 4-6) and the frozen parent fixture.

Identical strict parsing rule: the full completion must be valid JSON matching the schema ({"action":"click","selector":"..."} or {"action":"answer","text":"..."}); any parse error, schema violation or missing required field is a parse failure.
Identical mechanical verification: Playwright drives system Chrome; success = clicked_reveal AND revealed_value==TARGET-42 AND final_answer==TARGET-42, with terminal page-state re-verification.
Constrained JSON decoding (GBNF) enforced for ALL candidate-model arms (treatment and comparator) to isolate model reasoning from formatting failures.

Same environment and serving stack as parent: llama-cpp-python 0.2.90, chat_format=qwen, n_ctx=2048, temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, seeds 42+episode_idx (episode seeds 42-46), CPU-only nproc=4, no GPU.

Candidate model set frozen: M-7B-QWEN (primary) then M-3B-QWEN (fallback); same model family/quantization as parent (Qwen2.5 Q4_K_M), artifacts sha256-pinned from parent provisioning evidence; no post-freeze model additions and no census beyond the two local candidates plus carried references.

Each model is measured under TWO prompt conditions (treatment vs comparator) whenever the experiment converges to the negative branch, giving a complete within-experiment 2x2 (model x prompt) evidence matrix with identical seeds for both conditions.

New diagnostic metric answer_action_emission_rate (fraction of episodes where at least one valid answer action is emitted) added to the parent stable metric set; it directly measures the VF-01 re-click-loop transition.

Raw evidence preserved per condition: model receipts (download URL, sha256, bytes, load time), per-episode raw completions, parsed actions, click_ok, reveal detection, final answer, step counts, latency, completion tokens, prompt_condition tag.

Bounded external capability check (prereg section 8) is time-boxed (<= 30 min) and INFORMATIONAL: it records a structured capability envelope and feeds the pre-declared close/re-scope recommendation; it never overrides the local measurement outcome.

Deterministic protocol (temperature=0.0, fixed seeds): outcomes must be read as a deterministic-protocol result with zero within-cell variance, consistent with parent audit VF-03; the 3/5 bar is a pre-declared operational adequacy rule, not a significance test (see control_sensitivity evidence).
decision_rule: OUTCOME is exactly one of {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}. Candidates in order: M-7B-QWEN then M-3B-QWEN. P_treat = goal/schema prompt (prereg 4.1); P_comp = frozen underspecified prompt (prereg 4.2). PROVISIONING (before any model evaluation): GGUFs are located or (re-)downloaded via the confirmed huggingface.co resolve-redirect route and sha256-verified against the parent-pinned digests (prereg 8.1); any unresolved digest mismatch or download failure is a provisioning_failure for that candidate -> record deviation, continue with the remaining candidate (parent prereg 8 rule); if BOTH candidates are unprovisionable -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PHASE A (treatment, per candidate): A1 run PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING under P_treat; if pass_rate < 1.0 -> EXCLUDE candidate from treatment evaluation (decoding_infrastructure_failure), go to next candidate. A2 else run 5 task episodes under P_treat (seeds 42-46); candidate CLEARS the bar iff task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6. A3 if any candidate clears -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS, Status=COMPLETE, STOP (no further candidates, no comparator phase). PHASE B (after candidates exhausted, at least one was evaluated on task, none cleared): B1 run the full comparator phase for the evaluated candidate(s): PC under P_comp (reference only) + 5 episodes under P_comp (seeds 42-46), reproducing B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-* within this experiment; B2 run PC-ORACLE-EPISODE (scorer canary) if not already run; B3 run the bounded external capability check (informational); B4 OUTCOME=FALSIFIES, Status=COMPLETE. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reached only when: (i) every candidate was excluded at PC (decoding_infrastructure_failure), or (ii) PC-ORACLE-EPISODE is not 5/5 (scorer cannot register success), or (iii) both candidates unprovisionable. The external envelope never changes OUTCOME; it is recorded in metrics.external_capability_envelope and, per prereg 8.3, maps to the close/re-scope recommendation: if the envelope contains >= 1 credible published result of a credential-free-LOCAL 3B-8B-class model clearing an equal-or-harder multi-step Web-agent task at success >= 0.6, the recommendation is a bounded follow-up verification of that specific model+provisioning path in the factory before closing; otherwise the recommendation is to re-scope the four-arm benchmark off the credential-free path (drop Gate 3 same-model external anchor; require internally re-run comparators with retrieval-quality metrics on a dynamic-range task bank).
product_consequence_positive: SUPPORTS: readiness condition (3) is satisfied by a proven same-model driver. Gate 2 of the frozen C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark converts from FAIL to PASS at the goal/schema prompt protocol; Intel hands off the verified credential-free endpoint (model + exact prompt + harness config) so Product/Graph can run the frozen four-arm benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, same model/tools/budget) as specified. Audit VF-01 is retired with evidence: the underspecification was the actionable driver. C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL/VALIDATED; C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-PRODUCT-ECON regain an executable benchmark substrate.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIES: the credential-free 3B-8B GGUF path is exhausted under factory constraints (CPU-only, huggingface.co resolve-redirect only, llama.cpp 0.2.90) even with a goal/schema prompt; the parent's DESIGN_COMPROMISED boundary is confirmed protocol-stable, and U-01/U-02 in the parent audit are closed (the deficit is below the prompt ceiling). Deliverable: an explicit close/re-scope recommendation to the Global Research Director (per prereg 8.3 and decision rule): either a bounded follow-up on a specific external model flagged by the envelope, or the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark is re-scoped off the credential-free path (drop Gate 3 same-model external anchor; internally re-run comparators with retrieval-quality metrics on a dynamic-range task bank where cold/retrieval arms are not at ceiling, per the B2 precedent). C-LLM-INHERIT stays HYPOTHESIS until the re-scoped design is approved.
estimated_cost: ~60-120 min wall time total, CPU-only. Downloads: ~4.1 GB (7B split shards) + ~1.9 GB (3B), re-downloaded via huggingface.co resolve-redirect only if the parent-downloaded GGUFs (/tmp/opencode/gguf/, sha256-pinned) are absent on the EXECUTE runner; bandwidth ~0-6 GB. Inference (parent-measured 5.1 s/call 7B, 2.2 s/call 3B): worst case full 2x2 matrix = 2 models x 2 prompts x (10 PC probes + 25 episode steps) ~= 70 calls 7B (~6 min) + 70 calls 3B (~2.5 min) + 2 model loads (~2-3 min) + playwright episodes (~1-2 min). Controls: oracle 5 scripted episodes (< 5 s) + NC 5 + B-RANDOM 5 episodes. External capability check: <= 30 min bounded search (websearch + archived leaderboards). No GPU, no paid API.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in both directions (Director mandate: 'either satisfied by a proven same-model driver or the four-arm benchmark re-scoped off the credential-free path'). This is the single unresolved measurement named by parent audit U-01/U-02 and mandate blocker B3: it separates a prompt/underspecification artifact (would unblock the flagship four-arm benchmark at zero new infrastructure cost) from a model-capability ceiling (closes the credential-free path and triggers an explicit, accountable re-scope), and it inventories the demonstratable ceiling across ALL endpoints/models actually available (0.5B/3B/7B GGUFs + proxy + bounded external envelope). The within-experiment 2x2 also re-verifies the parent's comparator outcomes for harness-drift detection. Low cost (<= 2 h, CPU-only) relative to the decision at stake; the bounded external check prevents an infinite model census (mandate prior B2/B3 anti-pattern).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The decision rule is a 3-outcome FSM (SUPPORTS / FALSIFIES / MEASUREMENT_INVALID) with no unreachable branch: SUPPORTS is reachable because the treatment arm is structurally capable of 5/5 (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE proves the scorer registers success; the question the mandate asks is precisely whether the prompt converts click-to-answer, and the treatment differs from the parent failure only in the instruction/schema content that VF-01 identified); FALSIFIES is reachable because the parent already exhibits the full comparator failure mode (0/5, re-click loop) and the treatment may not fix it; MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via three explicitly enumerated infrastructure conditions. Thresholds are arithmetically attainable: 3/5 = 0.6 exactly at k=3; the bar is NOT at ceiling or floor (parent measured comparator at 0/5; an oracle canary measures 5/5; candidate cells are open in both directions). Precedence is a strict early-stop chain (A1 -> A2 -> A3 -> B), so no later branch shadows an earlier one: SUPPORTS short-circuits, FALSIFIES is the convergence branch, and MEASUREMENT_INVALID only fires when measurement is impossible. The external capability check is defined with an explicit non-gating role so it cannot create an ambiguous or unreachable MIXED branch.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is either verified-available by the accepted audit-PASS parent packet or explicitly carries a frozen failure path. (1) Models: huggingface.co resolve-redirect route confirmed (302 -> us.aws.cdn.hf.co); exact artifacts sha256-pinned in parent raw evidence (7B shards dfce12e3.../539cf93f..., 3B 626b4a66...); parent-downloaded GGUFs staged at /tmp/opencode/gguf/ with matching digests may be reused if present on the EXECUTE runner, otherwise re-downloaded and sha256-verified before use; digest mismatch or download failure -> recorded provisioning_failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch, never silent substitution. (2) llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 (parent-verified, load+generate success for both models). (3) playwright 1.63.0 + system Chrome /usr/bin/google-chrome (parent-verified, Chrome 154.0.8037.97). (4) CPU-only nproc=4, ~14 GB RAM (7B Q4_K_M fits; parent ran identically). (5) Harness code: reuses the audited frozen parent harness (no new machinery required for scoring; see freeze_artifacts_bound). No credential, GPU, paid API, or unreachable dataset is required. The only EXECUTE-time materializations (per-condition config transcriptions, oracle driver) are mechanical transcriptions of frozen packet content, not prerequisites that determine measurability.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment vs comparator differ in EXACTLY one variable: prompts.system content (goal/schema enumeration vs the frozen underspecified string); task page, user_template, GBNF grammar, sampling, seeds, harness and scoring are byte-identical. The comparator arms (B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-7B/3B) pin the VF-01 failure mode from the parent, so the design has an expected non-zero/non-identical differentiation surface: parent measured comparator at task_success_rate=0.0 with step-1 parse 1.0, while the treatment cell is open in both directions (0/5 to 5/5). Neither arm is at a ceiling (success would need 5/5 and no arm can exceed 5/5 by construction; 3/5 is not a floor because parent already measured 0/5 on the identical task) nor at a floor (the scorer can register 5/5 via the oracle; the task is mechanically completable). Carried references (B-0.5B-QWEN-LOCAL, B-POLLINATIONS-PROXY) are explicitly labeled non-re-run reference evidence for the 'ALL endpoints available' statement and cannot be confused with re-measured arms. Cost dimensions are identical between arms (same inference calls, same token budgets), so no comparator hides a cost dimension.

control_sensitivity.reason: Three controls fire under the SAME implementations that score the experiment, with pre-declared independent criteria. (1) PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING: 10/10 schema-valid JSON under the actual prompt condition; it is the decision gate isolating decoding from reasoning (parent: 10/10 for both models while task failed 0/5, proving the control discriminates infrastructure from capability). (2) PC-ORACLE-EPISODE (NEW): a scripted click-#reveal-btn then answer-TARGET-42 producer driven through the exact run_episode scorer must register 5/5 task_success, proving the full success path (click -> reveal detection -> answer registration -> final verification) can fire; without it a latent scorer bug making task_success always False would be conflated with model failure. (3) NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION stays null (0% parseable, 0% success) and B-RANDOM-ACTION stays at chance under the same scorer (per-episode success p = 0.04; P(>=3/5) ≈ 6.0e-4, pre-computed with exact arithmetic, so the 3/5 adequacy bar is unreachable by the random baseline). No control is tautological (PC-JSON is the only near-tautology and is retained solely as the inherited decoder gate; the scorer-path sensitivity is carried by the oracle) and none is impossible (all three criteria were either already observed in the parent or are mechanically scripted).

treatment_liveness.reason: C-LLM-INHERIT is a Product-relevant claim, so treatment_liveness is declared PASS, not NOT_APPLICABLE. The treatment is a system-prompt string variant (goal/schema enumeration) evaluated by the audited, fully config-driven parent harness; it requires no new machinery, model, or hardware. Liveness is verified by construction: (a) the harness executed real positive-control and episode runs in the parent under the identical configuration surface (probe-candidate and null-random modes), (b) EXECUTE transcribes a treatment harness_config.json whose ONLY field difference from the frozen comparator fixture is prompts.system (mechanical single-field replacement from the frozen prereg 4.1 string), and (c) PC-ORACLE-EPISODE proves at EXECUTE start that the scorer path can carry a click-then-answer completion to task_success=true, so a non-null executable treatment behavior is guaranteed before any candidate arm is measured. No frozen host-side code mutation is required (harness sha256 is bound in freeze_artifacts).

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: The experiment's operative code and fixture dependencies are exactly two EXISTING frozen files, both bound by hash: (1) research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py — the audited harness REUSED UNMODIFIED for all measurement (probe-candidate and null-random modes import its run_episode scorer); (2) research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/harness_config.json — the frozen comparator fixture that is the byte-template for both per-condition configs. Everything else is either remote content pinned by frozen identifiers/hashes (GGUFs: URLs + sha256 in prereg 8.1 / parent raw evidence; remote responses cannot be frozen) or EXECUTE-time materializations whose content is FULLY determined by frozen strings in this packet: (a) two per-condition harness_config.json transcriptions (byte-identical to the bound fixture except prompts.system replaced by the verbatim prereg 4.1/4.2 strings) and (b) the oracle driver research/intel/run_exp_38013769440_oracle.py, whose complete behavior is specified as pseudocode in prereg 6.2 (imports run_episode from the bound harness; scripted producer). These post-freeze transcriptions cannot change interpretation (their every input is frozen here) and are hash-recorded in result.json artifacts and provenance for diff-checking against this packet, exactly as the packet contract requires for post-freeze EXECUTE outputs. No other mutable local code/data/task-bank/fixture dependencies exist.
